name: Elira Stonefall
source_profile: ● Elira Stonefall (NG) is a young surveyor and scholar. She believes the Karrathi cannot defeat the Cadorians militarily and favors negotiated boundaries. Her investigation of strange activity beneath the mountains has also led her to suspect that something more dangerous than settlers is emerging from the old dwarven tunnels.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 67 (source excerpt; may be partial)
